query: California Department of Public Health West Nile virus 2024 cases deaths surveillance report
query_rationale: CDPH is the primary authoritative source for statewide WNV surveillance in California. Their annual or weekly WNV activity reports will contain confirmed/probable case counts, deaths, hospitalizations, and county-level breakdowns for 2024, including the August window. Using agency name + disease + year in natural language is more likely to surface the correct landing page than rigid exact-phrase matching.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDPH West Nile virus surveillance page, annual summary, or weekly activity report for 2024
expected_trust_signal: cdph.ca.gov domain; official state agency authorship; tabular case counts by county and week

query: CDC West Nile virus 2024 California cases ArboNET surveillance statistics
query_rationale: CDC's ArboNET system is the national arboviral surveillance database and publishes state-level WNV case counts including California. The CDC WNV activity page is updated regularly during transmission season and will contain confirmed neuroinvasive and non-neuroinvasive case counts, deaths, and state breakdowns for 2024. This is a critical cross-validation source against CDPH data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC WNV activity and surveillance data page or ArboNET state-level table for 2024
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain; ArboNET attribution; tabular state-by-state case counts

query: West Nile virus California county August 2024 cases deaths public health department report
query_rationale: California WNV activity is heavily concentrated in specific counties (Los Angeles, Sacramento, Kern, Fresno, Riverside, San Bernardino). County-level health departments and vector control districts publish their own WNV activity reports and press releases, which may contain locality-level case counts and dates not aggregated in state-level reports. This query targets county-level official sources for August 2024 specifically.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: County public health department press releases, vector control district activity reports, or local health officer advisories for August 2024
expected_trust_signal: County .gov or .ca.gov domains; vector control district authorship; dated press releases or activity bulletins

expected_trust_signal: Dateline August 2024; direct citation of CDPH, county health department, or vector control district figures; named official spokesperson quotes

query: West Nile virus California death 2024 August hospitalization neuroinvasive disease
query_rationale: Deaths and hospitalizations have not appeared in any iteration 1 snippet. News coverage of WNV fatalities in California during August 2024 is the most likely channel to surface death counts and hospitalization figures, as these are typically highlighted in public health press releases and media coverage. The term 'neuroinvasive disease' is used in official reporting for the most severe WNV cases (encephalitis, meningitis, acute flaccid paralysis) and is associated with hospitalizations and deaths — including it increases the chance of surfacing severity-specific data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News articles or public health press releases from August 2024 reporting WNV deaths or hospitalizations in California, citing CDPH or county health department figures
expected_trust_signal: Dateline August 2024; direct citation of named official or agency; specific death or hospitalization count; California byline
